title: Verify: Expired Round closing unit tests with fake clock and Closer
summary: Unit tests for the expiry close path
description: Write backend/worker/internal/poller/poller_close_test.go reusing the fakes from poller_detect_test.go.
acceptance_criteria: Expired OPEN Round is closed once; boundary EndsAt==now closes; future EndsAt does not.
Closed ID appears in ClosedNow and Closed.
technical_constraints: Fake clock only; no real time

steps.action: Inputs: fake clock at 12:00 UTC; Rounds E1 OPEN EndsAt 11:00, E2 OPEN EndsAt exactly 12:00, F1 OPEN EndsAt 13:00. Assert fakeCloser.calls equals []string{"E1","E2"}, Result.ClosedNow equals []string{"E1","E2"}, Result.Closed equals []string{"E1","E2"}, err nil.
Inputs: Round C1 CLOSED and Round E1 expired OPEN. Assert Result.Closed equals []string{"C1","E1"} and ClosedNow equals []string{"E1"}.
